title: The Rich Seam
text: A vein of good stone and iron runs right along the path, close to the surface, gleaming in the wet rock. It would be a fortune for the digging. Yet every hour spent here is an hour the Gate stays open, and things come through it.

options.label: Dig all day; a fortune like this will not come again.

outcomes.text: The haul is heavy, and every tool is blunted by it.
The digging makes noise. Something comes through the Gate to see.

options.label: Take what lies loose and go, before the Gate notices you lingering.

outcomes.text: You take a little, safely, and lose no time.

options.label: The cleverest maps it for another trip when time is kinder.

outcomes.text: Next time you will know just where to dig, if there is a next time.
